enchantments.tooltip: Crown of Summer: You permanently benefit from Crown of Summer.Crown of Summer: You have a +15 Positive Healing Amplification, and you gain 10 Melee Power and 5 Ranged Power (all enhancement bonus).
Extra Smites 2: +2 Smite Evil uses per rest. Smite Evil uses regenerate 10% faster.
Hallowed: An item with this quality assists only wearers who have the ability to turn undead. Hallowed items provide an +13 Enhancement bonus to the maximum Hit Dice of undead turned.

Eternal Holy Burst: While you are wearing this item, your melee, ranged, and unarmed attacks gain the Holy Burst ability. (This weapon is holy. The weapon deals an additional 1 to 6 good damage each hit. Critical hits deal an additional 1 to 10 good damage for weapons with a x2 critical multiplier, 2 to 20 for a x3 multiplier and 3 to 30 for a x4 multiplier.)
Mythic Head Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
